_doc: Per-piece provenance for the cross-engine benchmark. This repo does not redistribute scores or analyst RN files — they are derived from the When-in-Rome submodule + fetched sources at build time (see corpus/prep/). 'events' = ground-truth RN events as the engine's parser counts them. 'in_common_subset' marks the 505 pieces scored in the head-to-head (all four engines produce output). See methodology/corpus.md.
